## Summary

Describe the problem and the implemented change.

## Validation

List the commands and manual checks run for this change.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior.
- [ ] Backend coverage remains at or above 80 percent.
- [ ] Frontend tests and production build pass when frontend behavior changes.
- [ ] Documentation and examples match the implementation.
- [ ] No credentials, generated runtime data, or scraped full content are included.
